excerpt: SK hynix disclosed in a regulatory filing on Tuesday that it will purchase 11.9 trillion won ($7.9 billion) worth of EUV lithography equipment from ASML by the end of 2027
notes: News report (Tom's Hardware, citing Bloomberg) of SK hynix's regulatory filing of 2026-03-24; the filing itself was not fetched. Order value stated but it is a forward purchase commitment, not annual revenue share, so no weight recorded.
